Many iconic football stars never played for Real Madrid despite high-profile links, including Lionel Messi, Neymar, Steven Gerrard, and Francesco Totti. Other notable players who never represented the club include Fernando Torres, David de Gea, and Gianluigi Buffon, who were often linked but remained elsewhere.

Players Who Never Played for Real Madrid:

Lionel Messi: The Barcelona legend was a long-term target but never played for Los Blancos.

Neymar Jr: Although he visited the Real Madrid academy at age 13, he chose Barcelona later.

Francesco Totti: The Roma icon, known for loyalty to his childhood club, rejected multiple approaches from Real Madrid.

Steven Gerrard: The Liverpool legend never moved to Spain, despite reported interest.

Fernando Torres: The former Atlético Madrid striker never represented his rivals.

David de Gea: Despite the infamous broken fax machine incident, the former Man Utd keeper never made a competitive appearance for Madrid.

Gianluigi Buffon: The legendary goalkeeper never played in La Liga.

David Silva: The Spanish midfielder spent his career at Valencia, Man City, and Sociedad.
